<string>Once there was a world without time. The world was<lf>nothing but white light, inhabited only by people and<lf>five dragons.<lf><lf>In that world, there was only eternity, and a sun that<lf>burned without beginning or end.<lf><lf>And because there was only timeless eternity, nothing<lf>was ever lost...yet nothing was ever gained.
<string>One day, the people began to wonder why their world<lf>had no beginning or end, so they asked the dragons.<lf><lf>The dragons opened their mouths as if to answer,<lf>but from their mouths poured water instead of words.<lf>It rushed out in streams to create the sky and the<lf>oceans, and the dragons swam away.
<string>The dragons swam to the center of the ocean, and there<lf>they began to transform into an island.<lf><lf>One dragon sank into the sea and became the land.<lf><lf>One dragon lifted its gaze to the sky and became the<lf>mountains.<lf><lf>One dragon stooped low and became the lakes, and<lf>scattered its scales to create the rain.<lf><lf>One dragon fell into a deep slumber and became the<lf>forests.<lf><lf>The last dragon climbed far into the sky to become<lf>a star of sapphire blue, shining brightly above the island.
<string>The people could not understand why the dragons had<lf>left, or why they had transformed.<lf><lf>Eventually, a lone youth decided to go to the island to<lf>seek the answers from the dragons themselves.<lf>He donned a simple cloak, climbed into a simple boat,<lf>and cast off alone into the murky seas.<lf><lf>At last, guided by the light of the sapphire star, he<lf>reached the Island of the Five.
<string>Some time passed, and the youth returned.<lf><lf>"Did you speak with the dragons?" the people asked.<lf><lf>"Yes, I spoke with them," he replied.<lf><lf>"Then tell us, why did they create the island?"<lf><lf>But the youth did not answer. Instead, he reached into his<lf>cloak and pulled out five dragon scales, which he gave to<lf>the people.<lf><lf>And then, before anyone realized, the youth disappeared.
<string>The people left their white world and sailed across<lf>the ocean.<lf><lf>Using the five scales, they created their own lands,<lf>their own mountains, their own lakes, and their own<lf>forests.<lf><lf>Last of all they created a bright moon, so that the<lf>sapphire star, which had guided the youth during<lf>his voyage to seek the dragons, would no longer<lf>shine alone in the sky.
<string>The land grew large enough to obscure the sun, and<lf>day and night were born.<lf><lf>The mountains, lakes, and forests breathed together, and<lf>the seasons were born.<lf><lf>The moon cast its light on the ocean, and waves were<lf>born.<lf><lf>And thus time was also born.<lf><lf>Swept up in the almighty current of time, the people<lf>came to know death. But the people also came<lf>to know life.
<string>Countless days and countless nights have passed since<lf>people first came to live on the lands they had created.<lf><lf>As time passed, they lost their memory of the Five<lf>Dragons, and even the memory of how time itself<lf>had been born.<lf><lf>But deep in their hearts there dwelt a quiet knowledge of<lf>the Island of the Five, the most sacred place in the world,<lf>which to this day sleeps in the middle of the ocean,<lf>uninhabited by people, and unchanged even by the<lf>relentless flow of time.

<string>The Argosy is in Port
<string>The Argosy is currently in port.<lf>You can obtain numerous items and materials from the<lf>Argosy captain or the Seliana Sailor that you can't get anywhere<lf>else and their stock changes every time they call into port.
<string>Restoring Health
<string>You can restore lost health by using potions.<lf>If you have some honey, you can combine it with a potion<lf>to make a mega potion, which restores even more health.
<string>Stamina
<string>Dashing, evading, and performing certain actions will<lf>deplete your stamina. Your maximum stamina will also<lf>gradually decrease over time, but it can be maintained<lf>by eating well-done steaks or rations.
<string>Crouching and Camouflage
<string>Press the dodge button while standing still to crouch.<lf>Crouching in brush grants you camouflage so you<lf>can hide from monsters.
<string>Sharpness
<string>Close-range weapons gradually lose sharpness with each<lf>attack. As a weapon's sharpness level falls, its attacks<lf>are more likely to be deflected, but you can restore its<lf>sharpness with whetstones.
<string>Health Drinks
<string>To increase your maximum health, drink nutrients or<lf>max potions, which can be obtained by crafting.
<string>Max Potions
<string>These powerful potions not only completely restore your<lf>health, but also restore your max health to its limit.<lf>Max potions can be crafted by combining a mandragora<lf>with mega nutrients.
<string>Scoutflies
<string>Scoutflies respond automatically to monster traces and<lf>many other substances in the environment. If you feel lost<lf>in a new locale, follow your scoutflies to discover points<lf>of interest as you grow accustomed to your surroundings.
<string>Tracking with Scoutflies
<string>Once you've examined a certain amount of a monster's tracks,<lf>your scoutflies will begin to detect more of them.<lf>Continue discovering more, and your scoutflies will be able<lf>to guide you to the monster's location.
<string>Preparing for a Hunt
<string>Prepare yourself for quests by carefully considering the<lf>best armor, skills, Palico Gadgets, and weapon element for<lf>the job at hand. Remember that you can also change your<lf>loadout at camp.
<string>Monster Parts
<string>There are soft parts of monsters that are weak to attacks,<lf>just as there are tougher, more resistant parts.<lf>Identifying a monster's weak parts is the key to<lf>becoming a successful hunter.
<string>Elements
<string>There are five elements: fire, thunder, water, ice, and<lf>dragon. Take advantage of a monster's elemental<lf>weaknesses to deal extra damage to it.
<string>Mounting Monsters
<string>You can mount monsters by striking them with attacks<lf>in midair. Once mounted, if you avoid getting thrown off<lf>the monster while you continue to damage it, you can<lf>knock it down.
<string>Mounting Controls
<string>Once you've mounted a monster, press <ICON PL_R2> when the<lf>monster thrashes about to hold on, or <ICON PAD_LSTICK> to avoid<lf>certain attacks. Be careful: you'll automatically fall off<lf>if your stamina runs out.
<string>Know Your Environment
<string>There are myriad endemic creatures and points of interest<lf>in the environment that will help you on hunts. You can see<lf>where and what they are by checking your map.
<string>Monster Clashes
<string>When large monsters encounter each other, they may<lf>end up attacking one another. Take advantage of these<lf>situations to turn the hunt to your favor.
<string>Breaking Monster Parts
<string>Focusing your attacks on specific body parts may break<lf>them, weakening the monster and sometimes limiting its<lf>mobility or its attacks. There are also materials that can<lf>only be gained from breaking certain parts.
<string>Using the Environment
<string>Observe your surroundings carefully. The environment is<lf>filled with ledges to jump off, walls to climb, and slopes<lf>to slide down.
<string>Wedge Beetles
<string>Wedge beetles can be found in many different places.<lf>Fix your aiming reticle on one and press <ICON PAD_RR> to<lf>hook on to it and swing across.
<string>Carving Materials
<string>Slaying a monster allows you to carve materials from its<lf>carcass. You can use these materials at the Smithy to<lf>forge or upgrade weapons and armor.
<string>Gathering Points
<string>You can get materials by carving monster carcasses, and<lf>also by collecting them from gathering points such as<lf>mining outcrops and bonepiles.
<string>Upgrading Weapons
<string>You can improve your weapons by upgrading them at the<lf>Smithy using the materials you collect on hunts.
<string>The Training Area
<string>You can test any of the fourteen different weapon types<lf>in the Training Area. To travel to the Training Area, speak<lf>with the housekeeper in your room.
<string>Armor Skills
<string>Armor is imbued with skills that carry positive effects and<lf>boost your attributes. Choose armor with skills that best<lf>complement your choice of weapon or play style.
<string>Investigations
<string>Investigations have different completion conditions than<lf>average quests, but they also offer better rewards.
<string>Armor Spheres
<string>You can upgrade your armor using armor spheres.<lf>Armor spheres can be obtained as quest rewards<lf>or by completing bounties at the Resource Center.
<string>The Botanical Research Center
<string>The Botanical Research Center allows you to cultivate<lf>various items. Additionally, you can increase the amount<lf>of items cultivated by applying fertilizer.
<string>Tempered Monsters
<string>You may find traces of especially fierce monsters—called<lf>Tempered Monsters—while on high rank or master rank <lf>expeditions. If you collect enough of these traces, <lf>you may receive new investigation quests.
<string>Traps and Elder Dragons
<string>Traps, like pitfall traps and shock traps, have no effect<lf>on elder dragons. These beasts cannot be captured.
<string>Automatic Material Storage
<string>Materials you gather on quests or expeditions are<lf>automatically sent from your item pouch to your item<lf>box upon your return.
<string>The Intrepid Field Researchers
<string>There are researchers within the Commission that brave<lf>the various locales to study a variety of subjects besides<lf>monsters. Find them out in the field and speak with them<lf>to learn useful tips.
<string>Info-gathering in Headquarters
<string>Headquarters is replete with knowledgeable members of<lf>the Commission, from hunters and handlers to researchers<lf>and engineers. Speak with as many people as possible<lf>to learn valuable information for your adventure.
<string>Camera Types
<string>You can choose between camera types in the options.<lf>Focus: Always fixed to the target.<lf>Target: Fixes to the target when you press the button.
<string>Camera Settings
<string>You can change various camera settings from the<lf>start menu.
<string>Multiplayer
<string>Up to four players can participate in quests.<lf>If you're having trouble hunting alone, take some<lf>friends along with you!
<string>SOS Flares
<string>During a quest, you can access the menu to send an SOS<lf>flare. This will put out a call to other hunters to help you<lf>with your quest. This is useful if you find yourself lacking<lf>the numbers to accomplish a difficult quest.
<string>Hunter Rank
<string>Completing quests will increase your hunter rank.<lf>As your hunter rank increases, you'll be able to take<lf>on more difficult quests.
<string>Fast Travel
<string>You can fast travel to camp by selecting it from the<lf>Wildlife Map, but be careful: You cannot fast travel<lf>while in combat or when a monster has been alerted<lf>to your presence.
<string>Damage Reduction
<string>It's not all about your armor or defense stat—the weapon type<lf>you equip will also change the amount of damage you take.<lf>Close-range weapons: reduce physical damage<lf>Long-range weapons: reduce elemental damage
<string>The Field Researchers
<string>You can keep track of where the field researchers are<lf>by checking "Field Researchers" on the World Map.
<string>Piscine Researcher
<string>A lone wolf of an angler who is an expert in his field,<lf>and in search of a new challenge, has come to the<lf>New World to head the piscine research for the field<lf>guide. He'll gladly share his fishing knowledge with you<lf>if you talk to him out in the field.
<string>Endemic Life Researcher
<string>A passionate researcher working on endemic animals and<lf>insects for the field guide. No one has a deeper<lf>knowledge of techniques for capturing endemic<lf>creatures in the New World.
<string>Lynian Researcher
<string>A wizened expert in the field of Lynian research.<lf>Though devoted to research into the Grimalkynes,<lf>he is outdone by the swift, sly targets of his studies.<lf>Now he is seeking a helpful hunter to aid him in his research.
<string>Elemental Resistances
<string>Increasing your resistances to elements reduces the<lf>effects of their blights and abnormal statuses, and<lf>may even negate them entirely.
<string>Traces and Tracks
<string>Very rarely, you might obtain an item after investigating<lf>monster tracks.
<string>Investigation Efficacy
<string>The higher your research level, the easier it will be to<lf>unlock investigations.
<string>Voice Chat
<string>Hold <ICON PAD_L2> and <ICON PAD_R2> and press <ICON OPTION> to see a list<lf>of the members in your voice chat.
<string>Auto-crafting
<string>Auto-crafting will automatically craft an item from your<lf>crafting list as soon as you have the items required to<lf>craft it. Press <ICON PAD_RU> to select the items you'd<lf>like to enable auto-crafting for.
<string>Accepting Guild Cards
<string>You can accept Guild Cards you've received by selecting<lf>Guild Card from the start menu. Note that you can only<lf>hold up to twenty unaccepted Guild Cards.
<string>Challenge Quest Records
<string>Your completion time for a challenge quest is recorded along<lf>with the date and time, displayed in Coordinated Universal<lf>Time (UTC).
<string>Guild Card Restrictions
<string>You cannot check or edit your Guild Card during a quest<lf>or expedition, but you can still send it to others.
<string>Chat
<string>Hold down <ICON PAD_TOUCH> to use the chat feature.
<string>Eating Meals at the Canteen
<string>The Canteen is a facility where you can eat meals that<lf>boost your health, stamina, and other stats. Meals also<lf>grant you the benefits of Food Skills.
<string>Meal Effect Duration
<string>Meal effects will wear off if you faint during a quest or<lf>expedition. They will also wear off once you complete,<lf>fail, or withdraw from a quest or expedition. After eating<lf>a meal you will be unable to eat again for a short period.
<string>Oven Roasting
<string>You can request the Handler to oven roast various items<lf>for you at the Canteen. It takes some time for the items to<lf>finish roasting, but once they're done you can claim<lf>them from the Canteen or directly from the Handler.
<string>Meal Vouchers
<string>Vouchers let you eat a meal for free.<lf>Though each voucher can only be used once, it also<lf>gives certain menu bonuses to the quest members in your hub.
<string>Augmentations
<string>Once a weapon has been augmented, you can no longer<lf>undo its upgrades.
<string>Ecological Research
<string>After gaining certain amounts of research points, you can<lf>visit the Ecological Research Center to increase your<lf>research level. You can also obtain valuable information<lf>about monsters, which is added to your field guide.
<string>Monster Research
<string>By collecting monster traces and increasing your research<lf>level, you'll learn more detailed ecological information<lf>about monsters, such as their weaknesses. Your scoutflies<lf>will also be able to better detect monsters that you have<lf>researched thoroughly.
<string>Bounty Updates
<string>The list of registrable bounties is updated whenever you<lf>return from a quest or expedition. Once you have registered<lf>bounties, you can review their details from the start menu.
<string>Bounty Rewards
<string>Once you've completed a bounty, you can visit the Resource<lf>Center to collect the rewards, which are often armor spheres<lf>and research points.
<string>Limited Bounties
<string>A limited bounty is a special bounty periodically<lf>made available for download worldwide, but only for<lf>a limited period of time. Be sure to complete limited<lf>bounties while they're still available, as each one is<lf>replaced by the one following it.
<string>Cultivating Items
<string>At the Botanical Research Center, you can hand over items<lf>such as plants, fungi, bugs, honey, and so on, to cultivate<lf>more of the same kind of item. Each item takes a specified<lf>amount of time to cultivate before it can be harvested.
<string>Fertilizers
<string>You can spend research points to use fertilizers at the<lf>Botanical Research Center. Fertilizers increase the amount<lf>of items obtained from each harvest or can be used to<lf>shorten cultivation time.
<string>Deploying Tailraider Safaris
<string>You can deploy Tailraiders and other players'<lf>Palicoes on expeditionary safaris, where they'll collect<lf>items & materials and unlock investigations for you.<lf>Safaris cost research points to deploy.
<string>Tailraider Safari Members
<string>The members of each Tailraider Safari can be chosen<lf>from the Palicoes of hunters you have exchanged<lf>Guild Cards with. The higher the Palicoes' levels, the<lf>better the rewards you can expect upon their return.
<string>Deployment Routes
<string>When selecting a route for your Tailraider safari,<lf>you may see some routes marked with additional symbols.<lf>These routes offer a higher chance of better rewards.

<string>Melding Items

<string>The Argosy only remains in port for a limited time.
<string>Great Sword
<string>The great sword has a long reach and powerful attacks.<lf>Because its sheer weight limits the speed of your<lf>movement and attacks, it lends itself well to hit-and-run<lf>combat tactics.
<string>Long Sword
<string>The long sword enables fast, fluid movement and combos,<lf>but it cannot be used to guard.
<string>Sword & Shield
<string>A lightweight weapon that allows for quick movement<lf>and fast attacks. The shield can be used to guard, but<lf>it may not hold up to certain attacks. It also allows you<lf>to use certain items even when your weapon is drawn.
<string>Dual Blades
<string>Use dual blades to unleash a whirlwind of combo attacks on<lf>your enemy. Though they're lightweight and relatively simple<lf>to use, they cannot be used to guard.
<string>Hammer

<string>Lance
<string>The lance is better at guarding than any other weapon.<lf>In addition to its long reach, its thrust attacks can be<lf>executed with little exposure to enemy attacks.<lf>Great for defense-oriented combat.
<string>Gunlance
<string>The gunlance offers more offensive power than the lance<lf>thanks to the addition of shelling attacks, and it also has<lf>good guarding capabilities. It may take time to master.
<string>Switch Axe
<string>The switch axe morphs between axe and sword modes.<lf>Axe mode boasts power and long reach, while sword mode<lf>features faster attacks and explosive finishers.

<string>Bow

<string>Elemental Swords
<string>The sword & shield's fast attack speed can make up<lf>for its relatively low attack power, especially if you combine<lf>it with a sword that has elemental attacks that target your<lf>enemy's weakness.
<string>Demon Dodge

<string>The initial shockwave created by the hunting horn<lf>Performance has high attack and stunning power, making the<lf>move completely viable as an attack in its own right. You can<lf>also chain a normal attack into a Performance, and then<lf>cancel the Performance with a dodge roll.
<string>Performance Effect Radius
<string>You can tell if a party member is within range of<lf>your Performance effects by looking at the icon<lf>next to their name.
<string>Power Guard

<string>Dash Stepping and Guard Dashing
<string>By combining Dash Steps with Guard Dashes, you should<lf>be able to stick close enough to a monster to maintain<lf>your offensive.

<string>During a dash attack, you can also perform other actions<lf>like sidesteps, 180-degree turns, jumps, and guards.

<string>Master Rank I

<string>Master Rank II
<string>Hunting large monsters in the Guiding Lands will increase<lf>your master rank.
<string>Ecology of the Guiding Lands
<string>The Guiding Lands support a complex ecosystem comprised<lf>of a number of distinct but mutually entwined regions that<lf>influence one another.
<string>Exploring the Guiding Lands
<string>As you investigate the Guiding Lands, some actions can<lf>raise the level of the current region, or lower that of others.<lf>Higher-level regions may attract more powerful monsters.
<string>Special Guiding Lands Materials
<string>Perhaps due to the Everstream's influence, large monsters<lf>in the Guiding Lands yield different materials than those<lf>encountered in normal quests. The stronger the individual,<lf>the greater the chance it will yield its species' unique material.
<string>Monsters of the Guiding Lands
<string>The monsters of the Guiding Lands have a high chance of<lf>dropping items when their body parts are broken. Use that<lf>to your advantage when hunting for materials.
<string>Special Guiding Lands Tracks
<string>When carving from monsters in the Guiding Lands,<lf>you may very rarely find special tracks that do not<lf>require analyzing.
<string>Gathering in the Guiding Lands
<string>The more mining outcrops and bonepiles you gather from in<lf>the Guiding Lands, the greater your chances of discovering<lf>gathering points containing higher-quality materials.
<string>Rewards in the Guiding Lands
<string>When you hunt monsters in the Guiding Lands, in addition<lf>to regular rewards, you'll also get additional rewards. These<lf>additional rewards will decrease every time you faint.
<string>Small Herbivore Monsters
<string>If you're careful, you can ride on small herbivore monsters.<lf>While you can't control them, they may dig into the ground<lf>and uncover an item for you.
<string>Hunter's Notes
<string>Take a look at the hunter's notes found in the start menu<lf>if you ever want to look up info on monsters, controls,<lf>or other useful tips.
<string>Fixed Item Display Settings
<string>You can adjust settings to display fixed items in the<lf>item bar or not. From the item pouch, select the fixed<lf>items you wish to display.
<string>Waypoints in the Guiding Lands
<string>When the quest leader in a Guiding Lands expedition<lf>sets a waypoint for a large monster, the waypoint will<lf>be shared among all quest members. When you want<lf>your group to focus on a monster that's appeared, be<lf>sure to set up a waypoint!
<string>Customize your Squad Card
<string>You can customize the appearance and text color of your<lf>Squad Card via the Squad Counter or the Edit Menu of the<lf>Start Menu.
<string>Zombification
<string>Once you have become zombified, you will not react to<lf>attacks and your health will regenerate automatically.<lf>However, certain actions like evading cannot be performed,<lf>and you won't be able to replenish your health. This status<lf>is a double-edged sword that should not be trifled with!
<string>Mixed Herb (G+R)
<string>This item not only cures you of zombification, but can also<lf>completely replenish your health. To craft this item, you<lf>must locate Green and Red Herbs out in the field.<lf><lf><STYL MOJI_YELLOW_DEFAULT>Note: Regular Herbs cannot be used to craft this item.</STYL>
<string>Safi'jiiva Siege Tips
<string>The Safi'jiiva siege is the most daunting task facing<lf>the Commission. Team up with other hunters in the<lf>gathering hub. Energy drained during your siege is shared<lf>with others in the hub, so don't worry about failing.
<string>Safi'jiiva Siege Objective
<string>The final objective of this siege is to slay Safi'jiiva.<lf>Force it to expend its energy and drive it to the lowest<lf>level of the Secluded Valley. Once a hunter in the<lf>gathering hub slays Safi'jiiva, the objective will be complete.
<string>Reward Levels and Broken Parts
<string>Reward levels increase as you break parts off<lf>of Safi'jiiva. Each part is weak to a certain type<lf>of weapon, so team with other hunters with that<lf>in mind to maximize your rewards.
<string>Safi'jiiva Breakable Parts
<string>Safi'jiiva's chest, back, tail, both horns, both forelegs,<lf>both hindlegs, and both wings can all be broken.<lf>However, its chest can only be broken under<lf>specific conditions.
<string>Softening Hide & Regeneration
<string>Safi'jiiva's hide is extremely tough, but can be<lf>softened by using the clutch claw. However, the<lf>part that has been softened will attack with more<lf>potency, and will eventually regenerate over time.
<string>Using & Absorbing Energy
<string>Safi'jiiva consumes more energy when it is hit by<lf>environmental attacks or by performing attacks while<lf>a hunter has gained its ire. It will absorb energy<lf>from the Everstream to replenish its own reserves.
<string>Drawing Safi'jiiva's Ire
<string>Safi'jiiva will begin to tenaciously target the hunter<lf>that deals a large amount of damage to it. Any<lf>hunter targeted by Safi'jiiva should try to keep<lf>themselves in its sights, while the other members<lf>of the party pile on the damage.
<string>Controlling Safi'jiiva's Ire
<string>Any hunter that has drawn the ire of Safi'jiiva must<lf>continue to attack so the monster continues to<lf>target the hunter, but failing to keep its attention<lf>will result in Safi'jiiva's movements becoming<lf>wilder and extremely dangerous.
<string>Gaining Safi'jiiva's Ire
<string>If you are not being targeted by Safi'jiiva,<lf>using the clutch claw to grapple onto its head<lf>and unleashing a flinch shot will draw its ire.<lf>This is a great strategy for switching its attention<lf>to the hunter best suited for the defensive role.
<string>Using Obstacles For Cover
<string>Safi'jiiva's gigantic breath attack has a huge tell<lf>before it's unleashed, but it can't be avoided via<lf>normal means, and will take you out in one hit.<lf>Only by taking cover behind something can you<lf>survive this devastating attack.
<string>Secluded Valley - 1st Level
<string>The first level of the Secluded Valley contains<lf>fragile ground and rocks overhead that can be<lf>dropped onto Safi'jiiva. If you can cause Safi'jiiva<lf>to stagger, you can force it to move and use these<lf>objects to your advantage.
<string>Secluded Valley - 2nd Level
<string>The second level of the Secluded Valley contains ledges<lf>and slopes you can use to perform jumping attacks.<lf>Take advantage of these, and then use the crags<lf>protruding from the ground as cover when Safi'jiiva<lf>unleashes its variety of breath attacks.
<string>Safi'jiiva's Explosion Resistance
<string>Some parts of Safi'jiiva's hide are so strong, damage from<lf>large barrel bombs and other explosions will have little to<lf>no effect. However, if you manage to break these parts,<lf>that resistance will also be lost.
<string>Safi'jiiva's Behavior
<string>Ordinarily, Safi'jiiva will not move, and will simply<lf>swat away anything that tries to get close to it.<lf>Team up with other hunters and attack it from<lf>a variety of angles without crowding each other<lf>to open it up to attacks.
<string>Breath Attacks
<string>Safi'jiiva is an extremely intelligent beast, and sometimes<lf>uses breath attacks that predict a hunter's movements.<lf>Try throwing off its prediction by changing the direction<lf>you're moving right before it uses one of these attacks.
<string>Elderseal Weapons Are Effective
<string>Being an elder dragon, weapons with Elderseal<lf>properties are effective against Safi'jiiva. While these<lf>weapons will force Safi'jiiva to expend more energy,<lf>their effectiveness will gradually fade, so don't rely<lf>on them too much.
<string>Safi'jiiva Siege Tips
<string>Check Safi'jiiva Siege Info in the start menu to<lf>see your progress in the Safi'jiiva siege.
<string>Utilizing the Guard Up Skill
<string>With the exception of a few attacks, all of Safi'jiiva's<lf>attacks can be blocked if you have the Guard Up<lf>skill activated. Breath attacks can also be blocked,<lf>and can be used to provide cover for your teammates.
<string>New Features in Iceborne
<string>From new weapon actions, to upgraded slinger functionality<lf>in the form of the clutch claw, Iceborne's new features<lf>give you an advantage in any hunt.
<string>Massive Expansion: Iceborne
<string>Iceborne adds Master Rank, a new difficulty level above<lf>high rank. A new story featuring an elder dragon cloaked<lf>in ice, over 30 additional monsters, and a scope rivaling<lf>that of the main game, Iceborne offers a deeper hunting<lf>experience!
<string>Frostbind
<string>When you're afflicted with frostbind, ice will cover<lf>your legs and your movement speed will be impeded.<lf>Using the Iceproof Mantle will help mitigate the effects<lf>to a degree.
<string>Red Eye-con
<string>Against Kulve Taroth, the red eye-con on the minimap<lf>does not show whether she can be lured, but indicates<lf>whether she's enraged or not.
<string>Master Rank Kulve Taroth
<string>The objective against master rank Kulve Taroth<lf>is to slay her. You cannot complete the quest<lf>just by breaking her horns.
<string>Master Rank Kulve Taroth 2
<string>There are no pursuit levels or reward levels when<lf>fighting against master rank Kulve Taroth. Progress<lf>is not carried over to the next quest nor is it carried<lf>over to the Kulve Taroth siege.
<string>Breaking Alatreon's Horns
<string>Alatreon's horns can only be broken while in Dragon Active mode.<lf>Breaking its horns will cause the next active mode element to<lf>be a different element.
<string>Knockdowns via Heavy Weapon Damage
<string>Fatalis can be knocked down when you do a certain amount<lf>of damage using heavy weapons like the ballistae or cannons.
<string>Fatalis and Flinch Shot 1
<string>You can force Fatalis to lower its head by grappling to<lf>Fatalis while it's flying, and using a flinch shot on its head.
<string>Fatalis and Flinch Shot 2
<string>When Fatalis is down on all fours, focus on pulling<lf>off a Flinch Shot with your Clutch Claw. If you manage<lf>to send it flying into a wall you can cause significant<lf>damage to its head.
<string>Fatalis's Wings
<string>Fatalis will fly less frequently if you're able to<lf>break both of its wings.
<string>Fatalis's Final Form
<string>When Fatalis enters its final form, its torso will become<lf>red hot. Though its hide will soften, the power of its breath<lf>attacks will greatly increase. You'll need to break its head<lf>in order to mitigate the power of its breath attack.
<string>Seliana's Underground Passage
<string>A subterranean passage links the entrance of Seliana's<lf>Canteen and that of the Gathering Hub.
<string>The Gathering Hub in Seliana
<string>Seliana's Gathering Hub offers a robust line of services,<lf>allowing hunters access to the Armory, the Argosy, and<lf>Botanical Research without leaving the Lunar Terrace.
<string>The Gathering Hub Hot Spring
<string>Hunters can perform a variety of actions while enjoying<lf>a soak in the hot spring in Seliana's Gathering Hub,<lf>and watch the macaques' responses.
<string>Redecorating Your Room

<string>Equipment Display

Allowing the Kinsect to stay in flight<lf>longer makes it easier to mount a focused attack on a single<lf>body part or leave a large number of essence deposits.
<string>Additional Bowgun Parts

<string>Elderseal
